set.body:
Objective
Test whether canonical Transport expresses the expected saliency diagnostic more strongly than matched simple density baselines, and whether it predicts graded oldness-confidence for old and lure probes.

Scientific boundary
Post-court exploratory diagnostic. Preserve the frozen GW-18.10 result, identical out-of-fold trial support, and local-only response-linked outputs.

Acceptance criteria
- Decode response 1-4 explicitly and retain response 0 as missing.
- Estimate 20-to-100 saliency slopes overall and by old/lure probe for Transport, density sigma 80, density sigma 160, and registered density.
- Bootstrap paired Transport-minus-density slope contrasts by participant and item.
- Compare held-out ordinal-response log loss for base, base+Transport, base+density, and nested Transport/density models in crossed folds.
- Report old and lure probes separately and all declared density comparators.
- Keep private trial predictions ignored; add tested reproducible analysis and concise public results.
set.title: GW-20 Compare Transport and density saliency/confidence diagnostics
